items.headline: S&P 500 Posts Modest Gain Amid Mixed Global Sentiment
items.summary: The S&P 500 edged higher today, gaining 0.16% to reach 7653 points, indicating a slight recovery following a broad market slide on Thursday. Investor sentiment remains cautious as rising Treasury yields and elevated oil prices continue to fuel inflation concerns. Global markets were mixed, with Asian shares showing varied performance.

items.headline: Nordson Leads S&P 500 Gainers
items.summary: Nordson Corporation saw an 8.0% increase, closing at $334.70.

items.headline: Coinbase Global Rises
items.summary: Coinbase Global gained 7.6% to finish at $172.35.

items.headline: Moderna Falls Significantly
items.summary: Moderna was the weakest S&P 500 stock, dropping 23.5% to $133.32.

items.headline: Walmart Declines on Weak Sales
items.summary: Walmart shares tumbled 9.2% to approximately $103.84 after missing Wall Street's expectations for quarterly comparable sales, impacting consumer sectors.

items.headline: Global PMI Data and UK Retail Sales Released
items.summary: Flash August S&P PMIs were released globally today. In Japan, July CPI inflation rose to 1.9% year-over-year, with the preliminary Manufacturing PMI rebounding to 55.1 points. Meanwhile, UK retail sales for July dropped by 0.5% month-over-month, below forecasts.

items.headline: Treasury Yields Rebound, Fuelling Inflation Fears
items.summary: U.S. Treasury yields have rebounded, despite the Treasury Department's announcement to increase bond buybacks, indicating market impatience with public finances. This, coupled with elevated oil prices and ongoing tensions, continues to ignite investor fears over inflationary pressures and potential rate hikes.

items.headline: Consumer Sectors Under Pressure Following Retail Earnings
items.summary: The consumer staples and consumer discretionary sectors faced headwinds on Thursday, with Walmart's disappointing quarterly comparable sales report leading to a 9.2% drop in its shares and dragging down rival retailers.

items.headline: Key Companies Report Earnings Today
items.summary: Several companies released earnings reports today, August 21, 2026, including The Buckle, Inc., Flowers Foods, Inc., BJ's Wholesale Club Holdings, Inc., and KE Holdings Inc.
